Below is a quick‑start guide for pulling the **comments** that Delta has collected for a particular domain (e.g., `apple.com`) using your personal **`delta_key`**. I’ll cover the most common ways to do this: | Method | What you’ll need | How to call it | |--------|------------------|----------------| | **HTTP/REST** (raw `curl` or any HTTP client) | • Your `delta_key` (string)
• A tool that can make HTTPS requests (curl, Postman, Insomnia, etc.) | `GET https://api.delta.com/v1/domains//comments` with the key in the header | | **Python (requests)** | • `requests` library (`pip install requests`) | See the code snippet below | | **Node.js (axios)** | • `axios` library (`npm i axios`) | See the code snippet below | | **Official Delta SDK** (if you’re using one) | • Install the SDK (`pip install deltapy`, `npm i deltapy`, etc.) | See the SDK docs – usually `client.get_comments(domain)` | --- ## 1. Using the REST API directly ### Endpoint ``` GET https://api.delta.com/v1/domains/{domain}/comments ``` Replace `{domain}` with the domain you’re interested in (e.g., `apple.com`). ### Required Header ``` Authorization: Bearer ``` > **Tip:** Some older integrations use `X-Delta-Key` instead of the bearer token. If you hit a 401, try swapping the header name. ### Optional Query Parameters | Parameter | Type | Description | Example | |-----------|------|-------------|---------| | `page` | int | Pagination page number | `page=2` | | `per_page` | int | Number of comments per page (max 100) | `per_page=50` | | `from_date` | ISO8601 | Start of date range (inclusive) | `from_date=2024-01-01T00:00:00Z` | | `to_date` | ISO8601 | End of date range (exclusive) | `to_date=2024-02-01T00:00:00Z` | | `sort_by` | string | Field to sort on (`date`, `score`, etc.) | `sort_by=date` | | `order` | string | `asc` or `desc` | `order=desc` | ### Sample `curl` Command ```bash curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_DELTA_KEY" \ "https://api.delta.com/v1/domains/apple.com/comments?per_page=20" ``` --- ## 2. Quick Python Example ```python import requests import json DELTA_KEY = "YOUR_DELTA_KEY" # <-- put your key here DOMAIN = "apple.com" url = f"https://api.delta.com/v1/domains/{DOMAIN}/comments" headers = { "Authorization": f"Bearer {DELTA_KEY}", "Accept": "application/json", } params = { "per_page": 20, # optional "sort_by": "date", # optional "order": "desc", # optional } response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params) if response.status_code == 200: data = response.json() print(json.dumps(data, indent=2)) else: print(f"Error {response.status_code}: {response.text}") ``` > **What you’ll see:** > The JSON payload will contain an array of comment objects, each with fields like `id`, `text`, `source`, `date`, `score`, etc. > If pagination is needed, look for a `next_page` link or a `total_pages` field in the response. --- ## 3. Node.js (Axios) Example ```js const axios = require('axios'); const DELTA_KEY = 'YOUR_DELTA_KEY'; const DOMAIN = 'apple.com'; const url = `https://api.delta.com/v1/domains/${DOMAIN}/comments`; axios.get(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${DELTA_KEY}`, Accept: 'application/json', }, params: { per_page: 20, sort_by: 'date', order: 'desc', } }) .then(res => console.log(JSON.stringify(res.data, null, 2))) .catch(err => console.error(`Error ${err.response?.status}: ${err.message}`)); ``` --- ## 4. Using the Official SDK (Python) If you prefer a higher‑level wrapper: ```bash pip install deltapy # or pip install deltapy[async] for async support ``` ```python from deltapy import DeltaClient client = DeltaClient(api_key="YOUR_DELTA_KEY") comments = client.get_comments(domain="apple.com", per_page=20) print(comments) ``` > **SDK docs**: Check the official documentation for advanced filtering, pagination helpers, and caching options. --- ## 5. Common Pitfalls & Troubleshooting | Issue | Likely Cause | Fix | |-------|--------------|-----| | 401 Unauthorized | Wrong key or missing header | Double‑check the key; ensure you’re using `Authorization: Bearer ` | | 404 Not Found | Domain not indexed yet | Wait a few minutes after adding the domain to Delta, or verify the domain spelling | | 429 Too Many Requests | Rate limit exceeded | Add `Retry-After` header logic or back‑off; check your plan’s limits | | Empty results | No comments collected yet | Verify that Delta has crawled the domain; check the “Crawl Status” tab in the UI | --- ## 6. Next Steps * **Pagination** – If you need more than the default page size, iterate over `next_page` links until you’ve fetched all pages. * **Filtering** – Use `from_date`/`to_date` to narrow the time window, or `source` to pull only certain comment types (e.g., “reviews”, “social media”). * **Export** – The API returns JSON; you can pipe it into CSV or a database for further analysis. Let me know if you’d like a deeper dive into any of these topics—happy to walk through pagination logic, error handling patterns, or even setting up a scheduled job to pull comments nightly!
